machine: Apple M1 Max, 32 GB unified memory
scope: Production adoption of MPSGraph fused scaled-dot-product attention at 1024x1024

implementation.shape: 32 heads, dimension 128, 4096 image rows plus 31 prompt rows
implementation.inputs: Row-major FP32 Q and padded row-major FP16 K/V
implementation.graph_work: Cast Q to FP16, transpose row/head dimensions, fused SDPA, transpose output, and cast output to FP32
implementation.prefill_mask: Additive FP16 block-causal mask preserving causal text and bidirectional image attention
implementation.cached_mask: None; all 4096 image queries attend the 31 cached prompt rows and all image rows
implementation.command_buffer: MPSCommandBuffer wrapper is required because MPSGraph uses commitAndContinue internally
implementation.resolution_policy: MPSGraph at 1024 only; custom Flash Attention remains selected at 256 and the exact two-query kernel remains selected at 512

rejected_at_256.decision: Retain the custom Flash Attention kernel because the 1.8-3.8% isolated difference is noise-sized and does not justify graph command overhead.

measurement_notes: MPSGraph commitAndContinue fragments the command buffer, so its single gpu_ms field is not a complete integrated-step measurement. Integrated comparisons use step and loop wall time.
macOS pmset reported 'Now drawing from AC Power' while also reporting the battery as '100%; discharging'. No stronger power-state claim is made; acceptance uses adjacent A/B pairs in both orders.
The one- and two-step runs exclude text encoding, VAE decoding, and PNG output and are prefixes of the canonical 40-step schedule.
No official complete 1024 trajectory oracle exists. The fused operator passes its scalar-FP32 gate and shared runtime plumbing passes the official 256 one-, two-, and forty-step trajectory gates.
